mapper.sql:
SELECT 'COMPLAINT' AS dispute_type, c.id AS dispute_id, c.complaint_no AS dispute_no, c.order_id, o.order_no, c.unit_id, ou.unit_no, me.region_code, c.status, c.content, c.result_desc, c.create_time FROM lb_complaint c INNER JOIN lb_order_info o ON o.id = c.order_id AND o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND o.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN lb_order_unit ou ON ou.id = c.unit_id AND ou.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND ou.deleted = b'0' INNER JOIN lb_merchant_entry me ON me.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND me.merchant_id = o.merchant_id AND me.status = 'APPROVED' AND me.deleted = b'0' AND me.id = ( SELECT MAX(me_latest.id) FROM lb_merchant_entry me_latest WHERE me_latest.tenant_id = me.tenant_id AND me_latest.merchant_id = me.merchant_id AND me_latest.status = 'APPROVED' AND me_latest.deleted = b'0' ) WHERE c.deleted = b'0' AND me.region_code IN
#{regionCode}

SELECT 'APPEAL' AS dispute_type, ap.id AS dispute_id, ap.appeal_no AS dispute_no, ap.order_id, o.order_no, ap.unit_id, ou.unit_no, me.region_code, ap.status, ap.content, COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.audit_remark, ''), ap.reject_reason) AS result_desc, ap.create_time FROM lb_appeal ap INNER JOIN lb_order_info o ON o.id = ap.order_id AND o.tenant_id = ap.tenant_id AND o.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN lb_order_unit ou ON ou.id = ap.unit_id AND ou.tenant_id = ap.tenant_id AND ou.deleted = b'0' INNER JOIN lb_merchant_entry me ON me.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND me.merchant_id = o.merchant_id AND me.status = 'APPROVED' AND me.deleted = b'0' AND me.id = ( SELECT MAX(me_latest.id) FROM lb_merchant_entry me_latest WHERE me_latest.tenant_id = me.tenant_id AND me_latest.merchant_id = me.merchant_id AND me_latest.status = 'APPROVED' AND me_latest.deleted = b'0' ) WHERE ap.deleted = b'0' AND me.region_code IN
#{regionCode}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.create_time >= #{todayStart} AND u.create_time < #{tomorrowStart} THEN u.id END) AS today_new_user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.promoter_id) AS bound_promoter_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS relation_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.convert_status = 'CONVERTED' THEN pr.id END) AS converted_relation_count, COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) AS commission_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN co.id IS NOT NULL AND co.status <> 'REFUNDED' THEN COALESCE(co.commission_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS commission_amount FROM lb_user u INNER JOIN lb_user_address a ON a.user_id = u.id AND a.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND a.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN lb_promoter_relation pr ON pr.user_id = u.id AND pr.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND pr.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN lb_commission_order co ON co.user_id = pr.user_id AND co.promoter_id = pr.promoter_id AND co.tenant_id = pr.tenant_id AND co.deleted = b'0' WHERE u.deleted = b'0'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS convert_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.order_amount), 0) AS trade_amount FROM lb_order_info o INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT co.tenant_id, co.source_order_id FROM lb_commission_order co INNER JOIN lb_promoter_relation pr ON pr.user_id = co.user_id AND pr.promoter_id = co.promoter_id AND pr.tenant_id = co.tenant_id AND pr.deleted = b'0' INNER JOIN lb_user u ON u.id = co.user_id AND u.tenant_id = co.tenant_id AND u.deleted = b'0' INNER JOIN lb_user_address a ON a.user_id = u.id AND a.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE co.deleted = b'0' AND co.status <> 'REFUNDED' AND co.source_order_id IS NOT NULL
) converted_order ON converted_order.source_order_id = o.id AND converted_order.tenant_id = o.tenant_id WHERE o.deleted = b'0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lb_order_info o WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.deleted = b'0'
